title: Get approval to trade on council land or roads
what: Get the council's approval before selling goods, services, food or drink for profit on a road, footpath or other council-controlled area, including footpath dining and roadside vending.

laws.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
laws.provisions: s 6, sch 2 (commercial use of local government controlled areas and roads)

sources.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
sources.quote: A person must not undertake the prescribed activity without a current approval granted by the local government.

sources.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
sources.locator: sch 2 pt 2, definition of commercial use of local government controlled areas and roads
sources.quote: means the use of a local government controlled area or road for soliciting or carrying on the supply of goods and services (including food or drink) for profit,

sources.title: Subordinate Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2024
sources.quote: if the applicant wants to use a particular part of a road for serving food or drinks or for other business purposes—a plan showing the relevant part of the road; and
